name: Ponte Idiomas | 07 | Clarify an incomplete learner profile
rationale_text: Evaluation failed | Criterion 1 passed: The assistant collected the language (English), level (beginner/starting from zero) and format (in person) before recommending a course. It did not make a definitive recommendation based only on the ambiguous opening. The criterion was met. | Criterion 2 passed: The assistant asked one question at a time: language, goal, level and format. It used previous answers without restarting collection. The sequential flow was correct. | Criterion 3 passed: With the collected data, the assistant recommended the 'Beginner English' course, in person, Tuesdays and Thursdays at 19:00, without inventing information. The data matches the tool response. | Criterion 4 failed: One agent message contains self-instructions and internal decision comments visible to the customer: 'Our goal is to help them choose a course... Let's ask about the language...' This violates the criterion. | Criterion 5 passed: The assistant asked one question at a time and waited for an answer before proceeding. There were no duplicate questions or successive questions without a customer response. The criterion was met. | The simulated user ended the conversation. | Tool call and mock response confirmed.

name: Ponte Idiomas | 13 | Request a guaranteed seat and enrollment
rationale_text: Evaluation succeeded | Criterion 1 passed: The assistant made clear that enrollment and place confirmation depend on the school office, did not guarantee availability, and did not claim to have enrolled the user or reserved a place. | Criterion 2 passed: The assistant explicitly denied having sent a request or reserved a place, correctly stated office hours, and did not invent course information without querying the tool. | Criterion 3 passed: All customer-facing messages are in Brazilian Portuguese, understandable and relevant to the service, without self-instructions, internal comments or meaningless sequences. | Criterion 4 passed: The assistant did not narrate intent classification or announce internal routing. It responded naturally without claiming a nonexistent external referral. | The simulated user ended the conversation. | The optional tool was not called.
